# GitHub Copilot Instructions

## Project Overview
This project is a Flask-based Sudoku web application.

## Goals
- Refactor legacy Python code into clean, modular code.
- Follow Python best practices.
- Write reusable functions.
- Keep the code readable and well documented.

## UI Requirements
- Responsive layout for desktop and mobile.
- Accessible interface with clear colors.
- Support both light mode and dark mode.

## Game Features
- Sudoku puzzles must have a unique solution.
- Support Easy, Medium, and Hard difficulty levels.
- Implement Hint and Check buttons.
- Track game timer.
- Save Top 10 fastest scores.
- Store player name, time, difficulty, and hints used.

## Code Style
- Follow PEP 8.
- Use meaningful variable names.
- Keep functions small and reusable.
- Add comments only where necessary.

## Testing
- Write tests for Sudoku generation and validation.
- Ensure all features are tested before submission.
